claims.statement: Tom Allen won back the heavyweight title from Mike McCoole in a return match in 1873.
claims.excerpt: In the return match Allen took care that he would be protected and he won back his title.

claims.statement: In 1869, Mike McCoole got an undeserved verdict over Tom Allen in a fight on an island in the Mississippi; the referee declined to decide at the time.
claims.excerpt: Mike McCoole had got an undeserved verdict over Allen.

claims.statement: A later defeat by Joe Goss sent Tom Allen out of contention for the title.
claims.excerpt: A defeat by Joe Goss later sent Allen to the discard.
